groups.canonical_name: Manufacturing equipment obsolescence and early retirement
groups.definition: Product or process changes may force early retirement of installed manufacturing equipment, causing accelerated depreciation charges.

groups.canonical_name: Semiconductor technological obsolescence and price erosion
groups.definition: Rapid technological change, shortening product life cycles and price erosion may render products obsolete and erode returns on R&D investment.

groups.canonical_name: Excess and obsolete inventory from forecasting
groups.definition: Inaccurate manufacturing forecasts may produce excess or obsolete inventory, leading to write-downs and reduced margins.

groups.canonical_name: Automotive technology shift and product obsolescence
groups.definition: Shifts to electrified, autonomous and ADAS-equipped vehicles may make existing automotive products obsolete and require heavy innovation investment.
